default.$description: default background for the focus areas on a page - containers (card, slideout, modals), headers, etc.

scroll.$description: background for transparent containers that is activated when scrolling content goes underneath.

overlay.$description: used for overlay behind modals and bowling-alley menus (add menu, menu, user preferences, fast find)

muted.$description: background color used for secondary surfaces (bowling-alley, footer, slideout background, amplify chat background)

hover.$description: hover state background for containers and components that: have a hover state and who's background color is background = default.

subtle-hover.$description: background for the 'bottom' of the application - page background underneath the bowling alley, headers, slideouts, cards.

secondary.$description: use for text that needs slightly less attention than body. examples include labels, tabs.

subtle.$description: use for text that needs less attention that body or secondary text, but more so than disabled text. examples include help or info text.
